note: Results the benchmark owners decided for single trials that the rules leave void: trials["<helper>/<job>/<trial dir>"] = {"result": "success" or "fail", "decided": the date, "reason": shown on the page}. tools/digest.py rejudge() sets the trial's result (result_source "ruled"), and a later run of the same trial is not counted (a result is never run again, PROTOCOL H.5).
